main.description: An owner renames a context, opens it to the public or closes it, locks it against direct additions, or changes what it says about itself. An absent field stays as it is. A rename keeps the address: the slug is what links point at. `public` opens the context and what is in it to everyone, signed in or not.

content.description: What the place says about itself (Slate JSON), replaced whole: a group's front page, the home's welcome.

data.description: What it holds beside that, replaced whole: `image` (a cover's blob id), `url` (where it redirects).

created_at.description: The date it is filed under, such as a meeting's own. `2026-05-01`, or a UTC RFC 3339 timestamp.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such context, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not an owner of the context.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An empty name, or a visibility that is neither.
